3.

It is stated that the petitioners are the owners and possessors of the various extents of agricultural lands, total admeasuring Acs.86.02 gts., situated at Thappetlamorsu Village, Ghattu Mandal,
Jogulmaba Gadwal District.

It is the case of the petitioners that their names have been reflected in the revenue records, the revenue authorities have also issued pattadar passbooks and title deeds in their favour and since then, they are in possession and enjoyment of the same.
It is the further case of the petitioners that they are also receiving rythu bandu and other incentives under various schemes introduced by the State Government.

sentences.text: Respondent Nos.2 and 3 filed counter affidavit stating that the lands of the petitioners were not notified or acquired by the National Highway Authority of India and they are not interfering with the lands of the petitioners in any manner.

5. Sri P.Harinath Gupta, learned Standing Counsel for the National Highway Authority of India appearing for respondent Nos.2 and 3 had submitted that the NHAI would conduct survey and they would take possession of the lands by duly following the procedure as contemplated under the provisions of the Act, 1956 if the lands of the petitioners are required for the purpose of the formation of the six lane access controlled Greenfield Highway leading from Hyderabad to Kurnool.
4 CVBR,J wp_207_2024 6.

Recording the above said submissions, this Writ Petition is disposed of directing the respondents to follow due procedure as contemplated under the provisions of the Act, 1956 and the Act, 2013, if the lands of the petitioners are required for the purpose of expansion of road or for any other public purpose.
There shall be no order as to costs.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, shall stand closed.
